segments.name: Omnicom Advertising Group
segments.description: Creative advertising brands providing strategic advertising, creative services, and content production to global companies.
segments.evidence: OA includes our creative brands, BBDO, TBWA, and McCann, which we acquired from IPG, and the brands included within the Advertising Collective.

segments.name: Omnicom Media
segments.description: Media planning, buying, optimization, and data analytics agencies serving global marketers across channels.
segments.evidence: OM includes OMD, PHD, Hearts & Sciences, as well as UM, Acxiom, Initiative and Mediahub, which we acquired from IPG.

segments.name: DAS Group of Companies
segments.description: Precision marketing and healthcare communications services including digital transformation, customer relationship management, and healthcare advertising.
segments.evidence: DAS includes Omnicom Precision Marketing and MRM, which we acquired from IPG and Omnicom Health, which includes IPG Health.

segments.name: Communications Consultancy Network
segments.description: Public relations and communications services including corporate communications, crisis management, and public affairs.
segments.evidence: CCN includes FleishmanHillard and Ketchum, as well as Golin and Weber Shandwick, which we acquired from IPG.
